USAGE:
  sediment db [-h] <operation> ...

  provision database roles or inspect and upgrade the schema

OPERATIONS:
  status       inspect the schema revision without changing it
  upgrade      upgrade the schema under an advisory lock; as the migrator, also
               grant and validate the roles
  check        report every failed role and grant check without changing
               anything
  provision    provision roles and migrate using isolated bootstrap credentials

OPTIONS:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
